IPT.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/3] The results of this small study suggest that the SPARX cCBT programme is engaging and may be effective in reducing depressive symptoms in adolescents excluded from mainstream education.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/4] Additionally, our finding that it was practical to offer the intervention to whole classes is important, given that the majority of students had symptoms of possible depression and that embarrassment about being seen to be depressed and low rates of help-seeking had been reported as major barriers to treatment (Fleming, Dixon and Merry, in press).

Source.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/3] The cCBT group demonstrated improvements in depression scores over the waitlist control as measured by the CDRS-R, RADS-2 and remission rates.
